mapper.select: SELECT b.`id` AS bid, b.`title`, b.`description`, b.`cover`, b.`isoriginal`, b.content, b.`ispublic`, b.`iscomment`, b.`issue`, b.`browsecount`, b.`likes`, b.`collection`, b.`typeid`, b.`userid`, b.`tagjson`, b.`isdel`, b.`createtime`, b.`updtime`, u.`id` AS uid, u.`username` AS uName, u.`nickname` AS uNickname, u.`avatar`, u.`email`, u.`description`, t.id, t.`name`AS tName, t.note FROM t_blog b LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON b.`userid` = u.`id` LEFT JOIN t_type t ON t.id = b.typeid WHERE b.id = #{bID}

SELECT b.`id` AS bid,b.`title`,b.`description`,b.`cover`,b.`isoriginal`, b.content,b.`ispublic`,b.`iscomment`,b.`issue`,b.`browsecount`,b.`likes`, b.`collection`,b.`typeid`,b.`userid`,b.`tagjson`,b.`isdel`,b.`createtime`, b.`updtime`,u.`id` AS uid,u.`username` AS uName,u.`nickname` AS uNickname, u.`avatar`,u.`email`,u.`description`,t.id,t.`name`AS tName,t.note FROM t_blog b LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON b.`userid` = u.`id` LEFT JOIN t_type t ON t.id = b.typeid WHERE b.userid = #{uID,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY b.`createtime` DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_blog SET browsecount = CONVERT(browsecount, UNSIGNED) + #{value} WHERE id = #{bID};
UPDATE t_blog SET likes = CONVERT(likes, UNSIGNED) + #{value} WHERE id = #{bID};
UPDATE t_blog SET collection = CONVERT(collection, UNSIGNED) + #{value} WHERE id = #{bID};
UPDATE t_blog SET cover=#{cover} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_blog SET isdel = #{isdel} WHERE id = #{bID}
